name: Skills match
description: Technical/hard-skills overlap between CV and JD.

name: Experience level match
description: Years of experience vs. JD requirement.

name: Domain/industry relevance
description: CV's industry background vs. JD's industry.

name: Career trajectory fit
description: Whether the role is a natural step for the candidate's history.

name: Soft-skills match
description: Soft skills the JD asks for vs. evidence for them in the CV.

name: Recency of relevant experience
description: How recent the JD-relevant experience is.

name: CV clarity/structure quality
description: CV text structure/parseability, independent of any JD.

name: CV likely LLM-generated
description: Labeled via an existing open-source AI-text-detector's raw score.

name: Job post likely LLM-generated
description: Same detector-based labeling, applied to JD text.

name: Interview-Readiness Score
description: Continuous (not categorical Low/Medium/High), consistent with every other aspect.

name: Culture/company-alignment score
description: Only meaningful when the job description itself says something about the company (mission, culture, values); otherwise the predicted interval is simply wide and reads "insufficient data" through the ordinary confidence path -- no separate on/off mechanism.
